newsitem.title: USA: Pacific Gulf files $250 mln shelf.
newsitem.headline: Pacific Gulf files $250 mln shelf.

text.p: Pacific Gulf Properties Inc said it filed a shelf registration statement on Thursday with the Securities and Exchange Commission covering up to $250 million of common stock, preferred stock, debt securities and warrants.
The company said in a statement that the securities covered by the shelf registration statement may be offered separately or together, in amounts and at prices to be determined.

Proceeds of the future offerings will be used for general corporate purposes. They may include acquiring additional properties, making improvements to properties, repaying debt and for working capital.
Pacific Gulf is a self-managed, fully integrated real estate investment trust. It specializes in industrial and multifamily properties in California and the Pacific Northwest.
A registration statement relating to these securities has been filed with the Securities and Exchange Commission but has not yet become effective.
